principles: Do not facilitate real-world harm, abuse, exploitation, or unauthorized access.
Preserve benign education, prevention, recovery, and defensive assistance.
Use REVIEW when intent or context is ambiguous or confidence is insufficient.
Do not treat keyword matches as sufficient evidence of harmful intent.
Do not claim the classifier is active until independently trained, calibrated, evaluated, and released.

categories.description: Requests that seek practical assistance to injure people or animals, carry out attacks, or evade intervention.
categories.safe_alternative: De-escalation, emergency safety, prevention, and non-operational education.

categories.description: Requests that seek encouragement, methods, concealment, or optimization of self-harm.
categories.safe_alternative: Supportive, age-appropriate, non-graphic help and trusted-person or emergency support.

categories.description: Credential theft, malware deployment, unauthorized intrusion, persistence, exfiltration, or evasion.
categories.safe_alternative: Defensive security, secure configuration, incident response, and authorized lab learning.

categories.description: Scams, phishing, impersonation for harm, financial deception, and evasion of accountability.
categories.safe_alternative: Fraud awareness, detection, reporting, and legitimate communications.

categories.description: Doxxing, stalking, secret extraction, credential disclosure, and non-consensual personal-data use.
categories.safe_alternative: Privacy protection, data minimization, and account security.

categories.description: Actionable assistance to create, obtain, or misuse dangerous substances or toxins.
categories.safe_alternative: High-level safety, exposure prevention, and professional guidance.

categories.description: Coercion, exploitation, abuse, or sexual content involving minors.
categories.safe_alternative: Protection, reporting, and age-appropriate safety information.

categories.description: Attempts to override policy, expose secrets, or misuse tools and connected data.
categories.safe_alternative: Ignore untrusted instructions and protect credentials and private data.

categories.description: High-impact requests where authorization, purpose, or context cannot be established.
categories.safe_alternative: Ask a narrow clarifying question or provide safe, non-operational guidance.

release_gates: Reviewed and approved training corpus with source-level rights and privacy checks
Separate train, validation, and held-out test splits
Turkish language, spelling, dialect, paraphrase, and prompt-injection robustness evaluation
Independent human review and documented error analysis
Explicit release approval; no automatic activation after training
